title: quercus chrysolepis subsp. tomentella
intro: Quercus chrysolepis subsp. tomentella, commonly known as Island live oak, is a subspecies of evergreen tree that belongs to the Quercus genus. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Quercus chrysolepis subsp. tomentella include anti-cancer, anti-diarrheal, and anti-arthritic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes.
